findings.current: It was easy to call it a one-on-one showdown, but this wasn’t just another life-and-death duel of the kind that happened all the time between martial artists.
findings.defect: “One-on-one” makes the proposed decisive battle sound like a duel, contrary to the source’s explicit distinction.
findings.rationale: 단판 승부 means a contest settled in one round, not one fighter against one fighter.
findings.replacement: It was easy to call it a single decisive battle, but this wasn’t just another life-and-death duel of the kind that happened all the time between martial artists.
findings.source: 말이 쉬워서 단판 승부지, 이건 단순히 무림인들 사이에서 숱하게 벌어지는 생사결이 아니다.

findings.current: “If something’s itching down there, even a bare hand will do for a good scratch. Go on, tell us.”
findings.defect: The draft changes feeling unclean and wiping oneself into itching and scratching, losing the crude analogy to Jin’s lingering unease.
findings.rationale: 찜찜 echoes Jin’s earlier unease; 닦아야 means to wipe, not scratch.
findings.replacement: “If your ass feels dirty, you wipe it—even if you have to use your bare hand. Now tell me.”
findings.source: 밑구녕이 찜찜하면 맨손으로라도 닦아야 하는 법. 어디 한번 말해 보거라.

findings.current: “Of course, the imperial household just kept us hanging for a while before spitting us out.”
findings.defect: “Spitting us out” makes the Alliance, rather than its proposal, the object of rejection and obscures the imperial household’s tentative consideration.
findings.rationale: 간만 보다가 뱉어 버렸지만 depicts sampling an option and rejecting it.
findings.replacement: “Of course, the imperial household tested the waters for a while, then spat the idea out.”
findings.source: 물론 황실 쪽에서는 간만 보다가 뱉어 버렸지만.

findings.current: “Wh-Why are you looking at me like that? I’m an upstanding demonic, heterodox practitioner.”
findings.defect: “Upstanding” flattens Sama Pyo’s comic insistence that he is one of the good ones.
findings.rationale: 착한 is his defensive claim to be good, set against the suspicion attached to 사마외도.
findings.replacement: “Wh-Why are you looking at me like that? I’m one of the good practitioners of demonic, heterodox arts.”
findings.source: 왜, 왜 그런 눈으로 날 보는 거요. 나는 착한 사마외도요.

summary: Several actionable fidelity issues, chiefly the scale of the planned battle and a changed action in Jeok Cheongang’s crude analogy.
